record.body:
## Correction

The PEP 723 source path must not be `/home/andrewyin/adaptive-artifacts`. That is this machine's home directory, so the dashboard process does not run from the orchestra environment anywhere else.

Point `adaptive-artifacts` at the sibling checkout with a path relative to the script file. From `dashboard/__main__.py` that is `../../adaptive-artifacts`. From `dashboard/web/__main__.py` that is `../../../adaptive-artifacts`. Keep the launcher argv as `uv run --script`. Do not edit `tests/test_dashboard_uv_env.py`. Make `python3 -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_uv_env.py::test_r2 -q` pass again.
